column4: dialect-gated: cmd/cleat-worker/a_tenant_is_dropped_on_real_databases_test.go's SQL Server arm needs CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, which this job (./cmd/..., CLEAT_TEST_DB only) does not supply. The PostgreSQL arm runs here. Measured 2026-10-30: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./cmd/cleat-worker/ -run TestATenantIsDropped -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly this one test.
